chunks: Muhammad b. Ibrahim b. Ishaq (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Muhammad al-Hamadani, the client of Bani Hashim, informed us. He said: al-Mundhir b. Muhammad informed us. He said: Ja'far b. Sulayman narrated to us, from his father, from Amr b. Khalid. He said: Zayd b. Ali b. al-Husayn b. Ali b. Abi Talib (peace be upon him) said:

In every age there is a man from us, the Ahl al-Bayt, whom Allah uses as a Proof over His creation. The Proof of our age is my nephew Ja'far b. Muhammad — whoever follows him is not misguided, and whoever opposes him is not guided.

key_terms.أهل البيت: The People of the House; the Prophet's household, specifically the Imams
key_terms.حجة: Proof (hujja); the divinely appointed authority who serves as evidence of God's guidance on earth
key_terms.يحتج: Uses as a proof/argument (ihtijaj); Allah establishes a hujja (proof) among humanity

ai.seo_question: What did Zayd b. Ali say about the Proof (Hujja) of every age?
ai.summary: Zayd b. Ali b. al-Husayn (as), the son of the fourth Imam and brother of the fifth Imam, testified that in every era, Allah appoints a man from the Ahl al-Bayt as a proof (hujja) over His creation. He identified the proof of his own time as his nephew, Imam Ja'far b. Muhammad (al-Sadiq), declaring that whoever follows him is rightly guided and whoever opposes him remains unguided. This testimony is significant because it comes from a member of the Ahl al-Bayt who himself was revered, yet he pointed to Imam al-Sadiq as the divinely appointed authority.
